note: Times in seconds on a 120 BPM grid (beat 0.5 s, bar 2 s). A line starts at `at`; render.mjs speeds a clip up (at most 1.25x) when it would run into the next line. v6: all your AI agents, one app (the client positioning: the subscriptions people already have). Only the app's own interface, from the showcase mock.

lines.zh: 你已经在用 Claude Code、Codex，订阅也付过钱了，可它们散在一个个终端里。
lines.en: You already use Claude Code and Codex, and you pay for them. But they're scattered across terminals.

lines.zh: myco 把它们放进一个 App。
lines.en: myco brings them into one app.

lines.zh: 选一个 agent，说一句话，它就在你的电脑上开工，用的是你自己的订阅。
lines.en: Pick an agent, say what you need, and it gets to work on your computer, on your own subscription.

lines.zh: 好几个 agent 可以同时干活，还能互相派活。
lines.en: Run several at once, and let them hand work to each other.

lines.zh: 别的电脑上的 agent 和终端，手机上，也都在这里。
lines.en: Agents on your other computers, their terminals, even your phone: all in one place.

lines.zh: 让它们按时做事，还能和你一起用小应用。
lines.en: Put them on a schedule, and they get things done while you're away.

lines.zh: myco：你的 AI agent，一个 App 就够。
lines.en: myco. All your AI agents, one app.
lines.say_en: Myco. All your AI agents, one app.
